title: Savings Account Opening Form
description: Standard savings account application for Indian retail banks

fields.label: Full Name (as per Aadhaar)
fields.help_text: Your complete name exactly as printed on your Aadhaar card, including any middle name.
fields.question_hint: Ask for their full name as written on their Aadhaar card.

fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.help_text: The day, month and year you were born. The bank uses this to confirm you are old enough to open an account.
fields.question_hint: Ask for their date of birth. Accept natural phrasing like '5th March 2001' and convert it.

fields.label: Mobile Number
fields.help_text: The phone number where the bank will send your account alerts and one-time passwords.
fields.question_hint: Ask for their 10-digit mobile number. Strip spaces, dashes and the +91 country code.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.help_text: Your email address, if you have one. The bank sends statements here. You can skip this if you do not use email.
fields.question_hint: Ask for their email address, and make clear it is optional and can be skipped.

fields.label: Residential Address
fields.help_text: Where you currently live. Include house or flat number, street name, and area or locality.
fields.question_hint: Ask where they live. Prompt gently for house number, street, and locality if the answer is too short.

fields.label: City
fields.help_text: The city or town where you live.
fields.question_hint: Ask which city or town they live in.

fields.label: PIN Code
fields.help_text: The six-digit postal code for your area. You can find it on any letter posted to your address.
fields.question_hint: Ask for their six-digit PIN code. Mention where they can find it if they are unsure.

fields.label: Occupation
fields.help_text: What you do for a living. Pick the closest match — the bank uses this to understand your income pattern.
fields.question_hint: Ask what they do for work. Map their free-text answer to the closest option in the list.

fields.label: Account Type
fields.help_text: Regular Savings needs a minimum balance. Zero Balance Savings has no minimum but fewer free services. Senior Citizen accounts are for people aged 60 and above and offer higher interest.
fields.question_hint: Explain the three options in plain language first, then ask which they want.

fields.label: Nominee Name
fields.help_text: The person who would receive the money in this account if something happened to you. Usually a spouse, child, or parent. You can add this later if you prefer.
fields.question_hint: Explain what a nominee is in simple terms, then ask if they want to name one. Make clear it is optional.
